Why behaviour changes: Shift from generic paints to premium coatings driven by growing DIY participation, desire for distinctive finishes, and trust in Jotun’s marine‑grade reputation.. How value is captured: Jotun captures value through higher margin decorative coatings sold directly to consumers, and through a network of Jotun Multicolor Centers that can upsell accessories and services.. Assumptions: DIY market in Scandinavia and neighboring regions will continue growing at a rate sufficient to justify new consumer channels.; Consumers will associate Jotun with durability and design, leading to repeat purchases.; Jotun can maintain brand integrity while selling through retail partners.. Predictions: If launched, a test market will show at least 15% of target households purchasing multiple Jotun decorative coatings within 12 months.; Surveyed DIY‑ers will rank Jotun’s durability and design higher than competitors in a controlled test..

T2: Automotive refinishers will adopt Jotun’s automotive coatings if they offer faster cure times, superior color consistency, and reduced labor costs compared to competitors, leading to higher volume purchases.
